_description: Dataset provenance for the TCSR paper: official sources, the paper's
splits, and the expected on-disk layout.  The code never downloads
datasets itself; place each archive under data/ as described below.
Split manifests (image-id lists) and the duplicate audit are part of

hrsid.citation: S. Wei, X. Zeng, Q. Qu, M. Wang, H. Su, and S. Shi, HRSID: A high-resolution SAR images dataset for ship detection and instance segmentation, IEEE Access 8 (2020) 120234-120254

paper_split.note: Parent scenes and crops remain within one split.

ssdd.citation: J. Li, C. Qu, and J. Shao, Ship detection in SAR images based on an improved faster R-CNN, Proc. CSAE; official release: T. Zhang et al., Remote Sensing 13(18) (2021) 3690

paper_split.note: Scene-grouped split: all crops of one scene stay in one split.

coco.citation: T.-Y. Lin et al., Microsoft COCO: Common objects in context, ECCV 2014

splits.format: JSON array of image ids (subset materialization, see tools/common.py:load_image_id_manifest)
splits.duplicate_audit: tools/audit_splits.py reports cross-split overlap (must be zero)

policy: One fixed image list per (checkpoint pair, draw seed); the same
draw manifest is shared by all methods within a checkpoint pair.
Generate with tools/calibration_manifest.py; seed namespaces are
disjoint across checkpoint pairs and settings (manifests/seeds.json).

licenses: Dataset licenses and usage conditions are preserved in the released manifests and documentation (see the paper's Ethics Declaration).
